address: The Zone, 7236 Al Takhassousi, Al Mohammadiyyah, Riyadh, 12362, Saudi Arabia
bio: A family-owned group of restaurants across the Middle East, it’s now the turn of Riyadh to enjoy Em Sherif Café, with its bright, light décor and extensive, well-priced menus of Lebanese favourites. Generosity shines through in the portion sizes – most dishes are easily shared – in the flavours they deliver and also with their price. It’s open early until late and the team ensures everyone is looked after. Whatever you choose from the various sections of the menu, save room for dessert with the riz bi halib not to be missed.
